lines: lodash, 70,475 B on the ownpad-settings page: the full build; lodash-es with named imports ships only what is used.
core-js, 33,259 B on the ownpad-main page: polyfills for browsers older than the build targets.
1,684,086 B in 6 pieces of 4 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
5 files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (190 packages, 937 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
